heard: in the eighth month of the second year of Darius the word of the Lord came to the Prophet Zechariah he was the son of Barakiah a man of Levitical clan in the ancient land prophesying to the Jews and Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel who was over them Zechariah son of Erechiah A link in the lineage of the prophets Between the sanctuary and the altar
